reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001318 (the melody read from 001318a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Isaac B. Woodbury's dates (1819–1858) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Woodbury_Isaac (Woodbury, I. B. (Isaac Baker), 1819-1858; SELENA, 1850); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isaac_B._Woodbury agrees; CCEH's page gives only the year 1842. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001318a.nwc). The tune ends on F#, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
